    The universal cover of a ray category #

    For a ray category P and a base object x₀, the universal cover P̃ has objects (y, u) with u : x₀ ⟶ y in the fundamental groupoid, and a nonzero morphism (y, u) ⟶ (z, w) is a nonzero f : y ⟶ z with w = u ≫ [f]; the other morphism is zero (Gabriel–Roiter 14.1; BGRS Section 10). Composition is that of P, replaced by zero when the composite vanishes. The projection (y, u) ↦ y is a functor P̃ ⥤ P (Cover.proj), P̃ satisfies the ray axioms, and the fundamental group Π(P, x₀) acts freely on the objects, transitively on each fibre (Cover.smul_eq_self, Cover.exists_smul_eq).
